title.rendered: Road Construction on Main St. & Ladd Hill – September

content.rendered: The City of Sherwood will be paving Ladd Hill to Sunset on September 17th & 18th. Then paving Main Street from the railroad tracks to Sunset on September 23rd & 24th. Please note the road closures on those days. Detour signs will be posted and traffic will be routed around those roads. Allow extra time for school drop off and pick up on those dates.
